stories.title: IRGC claims American Unmanned Surface Vessel struck in Hormuz
stories.summary: IRGC claims American Unmanned Surface Vessel struck in Hormuz Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said its naval force struck an American Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV) that had been "trying to breach the restricted area of the Strait of Hormuz". The IRGC said in a statement: “This strategic waterway, is under the control of the Islamic Republic of Iran, and any move by the child-killing enemy will be met with a firm response.” "The US must know that there is no other way than to leave the region and abandon its evil actions.”
